{{search|transitional feature in the animated series|the images seen in some games when locations are entered|location preview}} ---- An '''{{wp|Bumper (broadcasting)#Japan|eyecatch}}''' (Japanese: '''アイキャッチ''' ''eyecatch'') is a transitional feature in the {{pkmn|animated series}} that appears between {{wp|Television advertisement|commercial break}}s during an [[List of animated series episodes|episode]]. Sometimes, the 12 seconds available are used for two 6-second eyecatches or a single 12-second eyecatch. In {{aniseries|PTS}}, the only eyecatch retained for Western audiences was ''Dare da?'' (Japanese, kana: だ〜れだ？; translation: ''Who is it?''), which became ''[[Who's That Pokémon?]]''. Unlike its Japanese counterpart, it continued well into {{aniseries|RS}}, ending with ''[[AG040|Watt's with Wattson?]]''. It was replaced by ''[[Pokémon Trainer's Choice]]'', starting with ''[[AG041|What You Seed is What You Get]]'' and ending with ''[[AG145|Pasta La Vista]]'', when eyecatches disappeared in the [[dub]]. ''Who's That Pokémon?'' later returned in the {{aniseries|BW|''Black & White'' series}}, beginning with ''[[BW001|In The Shadow of Zekrom!]].'' Eyecatches continued in each later [[series]], meaning that the English dub episodes of {{aniseries|DP}} are the only ones with no eyecatch entirely.
